```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
movies
glimpse(movies)
names(movies)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))
```

```{r}
movies |>
  filter(!is.na(boxOffice)) |>
  select(title, boxOffice) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = ", ")
```

```{r}
movies_clean |>
  count(genre, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(audienceScore, tomatoMeter),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```
